capabilities: Log in and out of saved places to record presence sessions
Insert the current location into the active note without changing session state
Create and manage place notes with coordinates and detection radius
Append login/logout entries to place notes and a monthly timeline
Create per-visit notes seeded with time, location, and a place link
extras: Privacy note: with reverse geocoding enabled (default), coordinates are sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim; the optional IP fallback sends your IP to an IP-geolocation service. Both can be disabled and geolocation itself stays on-device.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record where you are while writing notes or to keep a log of visits to places stored in the vault.

relations.evidence: your coordinates are sent over HTTPS to OpenStreetMap Nominatim to resolve an address

summary: Location plugin that logs presence at saved places, inserts current coordinates into notes, and keeps a monthly location timeline.
